tieu_de: Business Analyst Senior, US Product, Agile/Scrum
dia_chi_raw: L'Mark, The Venture, 62 Tran Huy Lieu
mo_ta_cong_viec:
1. Requirements Gathering & Analysis
Collaborate with stakeholders (CEO, merchants, operations, customers) to gather, analyze, and clarify business requirements.
Understand operational workflows across POS, Merchant Services, and Booking systems.
Identify root business needs, perform impact analysis for change requests, and prioritize the product backlog.
2. Business Analysis & Domain Expertise
Analyze business processes for POS transactions, payment services, and booking management.
Define functional requirements for payment, merchant onboarding, reservations, appointments, and related workflows.
Ensure business processes align with compliance and data security standards.
3. Documentation
Prepare BRD, PRD, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and process diagrams (BPMN, Use Cases, Activity, Sequence).
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation.
4. Business & Technical Collaboration
Translate business requirements into development-ready User Stories.
Work closely with Product, Development, and Tech Leads during Sprint Planning and implementation.
Support technical feasibility assessments for third-party integrations.
5. Testing & UAT
Partner with QA to define test scenarios and validate business requirements.
Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with end users and ensure delivered features meet business expectations.
6. Change Management
Evaluate change requests, assess business impact, and manage scope changes through proper approval processes.
Communicate requirement changes to project stakeholders and delivery teams.
7. Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Prepare release notes, monitor requirement fulfillment, and recommend process improvements based on business feedback and product performance.
yeu_cau:

3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in a software or IT company.
Experience with POS systems, Merchant Services/Payments, or Booking Platforms.
Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum, requirements gathering, User Stories, BRD/PRD, and acceptance criteria.
Proficient in BPMN 2.0, process modeling, and project management tools (Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar).
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.
Professional English communication skills (written and spoken); prefer TOEIC 700+ OR IELTS 6.0+.Nice to Have
Experience with BPM tools (Bizagi, Camunda, Lucidchart, Visio, etc.).
Startup experience or relevant BA certifications (CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, OMG-OCEB).
